description:

Brandi Mathews goes missing, and only her mother seems interested in searching for her; when her remains turn up over two years later, police dig into Brandi's work and romantic partners to find her killer.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S08 E02 — Death of a Ladies Man
The shooting of local ladies' man Jim Cornwell outside his home takes July Fourth festivities on a tragic turn; after multiple suspects tied to Jim's romantic life emerge, a confession arises that shatters the image of an Ozark community.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S09 E01 — Uncomfortable Truths
Beth Kutz leaves work in Poynette, Wis., and never comes home; her disappearance sets off a firestorm of searches for this mother of two by the small-town community while investigators unearth the uncomfortable truths behind this beloved family.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S09 E08 — Money is a Motive
Casey, Ill. looks to their own citizens when they find out a house fire didn't kill Scott Collins, it was murder; secrets revealed about his life aren't enough to lead to his killer, it's his German Shepherd, who holds the key to solving his case.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:

The burned body of Sara Summer, a mother of three, turns up in a cornfield; the grim discovery sends the people of Trenton, Tennessee, fearing for their safety.

title: Murder in the Heartland

Suspects arise after the stabbing of a beloved mother in her Tomahawk, Wis., home; when another stabbing occurs the next day, detectives race to place her exes, a high school and a taco joint under the microscope.

description:

Religious leader Gene Spriggs creates a movement in Tennessee with teenagers and disenchanted hippies called the Twelve Tribes; the Tribes become a cult with accusations of child abuse, forced labor and a devotion to what they claim is God's will.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E06 — I Still Care About Her
A killer shoots a young woman dead in her boyfriend's Orlando, Fla., apartment; hours later, he turns up in a hospital bed 500 miles away with a gunshot wound and a bizarre story that unravels to reveal he's a lying, callous psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E08 — An Excuse to Kill Somebody
A New Hampshire town reels after police arrest four teenagers for robbing and murdering a 42-year-old mother and maiming her 11-year-old daughter; detectives uncover two suspects with the characteristics of sadistic psychopaths.

title: Signs of a Psychopath

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:

Jon Eason hopes every day that someone will murder his son Dylan in prison; Dylan Eason's life sentence without parole doesn't appease his father, who admits wishing for his own son's death is horrible but feels Dylan deserves it for his 2016 crimes.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

Christian Fuhr receives a life sentence, and his girlfriend, Ammie Turos, believes he is innocent; when she discovers he's guilty, her conviction is replaced by uncertainty, and she wonders if her life had been in danger the entire time.

description:

description:
S01 E01 — Suspect #1

description:

description:
S05 E01 — Second Chance at Death
While mourning the death of his wife, Julian falls hard for his much-younger co-worker, Teresa; for a time, Teresa's spunk lifts Julian's spirits until a sordid affair plunges him into an abyss.

title: Fatal Vows
description:

California beauty Pegye meets volleyball player Eric in Newport Beach, Calif.; with good looks and success, the couple appears to have it all, but hedonism comes at a price, and their dream life quickly becomes a waking nightmare.

title: Fatal Vows

A minister's son, Luther, falls hard for Anita, the daughter of a pastor; then, failure delivers a crushing blow to their relationship, turning their heavenly life into hell on Earth.
